```lean
theorem lg_target (p : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ p) (h1 : p ≤ 1) : p * (1 - p) ≤ 1 / 4 := by
  have h2 : p * p ≤ 1 / 4 * 4 :=
    calc
      p * p ≤ (1 / 4) * 4
      by rw [mul_one, one_div]
      exact (le_mul_right (1 / 4) 4).trans (le_rfl)
  rw [one_div, mul_div] at h2
  exact (le_div_of_le_mul_right (1 / 4) 4).mp h2
```
